comment: Every host the GitHub-Pages build may reference. Checked by src/artifact/externalHosts.dist.test.ts against dist/; a host missing here fails the build, a host listed here but gone from the build fails too. Categories: self (deployment origin), api (called only on an explicit user action with the user's own key), link (plain hyperlink, user must click), identifier (XML namespace / JSON-LD context, never fetched), vendor-docs (documentation URL inside a library error message, never fetched). Nothing on page view may contact a third party; the HTML tag check enforces that regardless of this list.

astrapi69.github.io.purpose: Deployment origin: canonical link, Open Graph URLs, sitemap, robots.txt.
astrapi69.github.io.trigger: Page view (same origin, the GitHub Pages host itself).

api.anthropic.com.purpose: Anthropic Messages API for photo recognition (PhotoIntake) and the key probe in Settings > AI.
api.anthropic.com.trigger: Explicit user action with the user's own API key: Recognize or Test connection. Never on page view.

api.openai.com.purpose: OpenAI chat completions for photo recognition and the key probe. CORS-blocked in the browser build, reachable only through a user-run backend.
api.openai.com.trigger: Explicit user action with the user's own API key.

generativelanguage.googleapis.com.purpose: Google Gemini generateContent for photo recognition and the key probe.
generativelanguage.googleapis.com.trigger: Explicit user action with the user's own API key.

api.perplexity.ai.purpose: Perplexity (OpenAI-compatible) chat completions for photo recognition and the key probe.
api.perplexity.ai.trigger: Explicit user action with the user's own API key.

github.com.purpose: Repository, MIT license and 'Report issue' links in Settings > About; license and PRIVACY.md links on the static legal pages; author URL in the JSON-LD block; exceljs upgrade note inside a library error string.
github.com.trigger: User click opens a new tab. The issue link carries the error detail, stack trace, browser and app version the user saw in the dialog.

docs.github.com.purpose: GitHub privacy statement, linked from the static privacy policy pages (datenschutz.html, privacy.html).

www.anthropic.com.purpose: Anthropic privacy policy, linked from the static privacy policy pages (datenschutz.html, privacy.html).

openai.com.purpose: OpenAI privacy policy, linked from the static privacy policy pages (datenschutz.html, privacy.html).

policies.google.com.purpose: Google privacy policy, linked from the static privacy policy pages (datenschutz.html, privacy.html).

www.perplexity.ai.purpose: Perplexity privacy policy, linked from the static privacy policy pages (datenschutz.html, privacy.html).

opensource.org.purpose: MIT license URL in the JSON-LD structured data block.
opensource.org.trigger: Never fetched by the app; only crawlers read it.

www.w3.org.purpose: SVG / XHTML XML namespaces (favicon, icons, React DOM, exceljs).

purl.org.purpose: Dublin Core namespaces exceljs writes into workbook metadata.

schemas.microsoft.com.purpose: Office Open XML namespaces exceljs writes into workbooks.

schemas.openxmlformats.org.purpose: Office Open XML namespaces exceljs writes into workbooks.

bit.ly.purpose: Short links inside workbox and Dexie warning messages.

tinyurl.com.purpose: Dexie 'IndexedDB API missing' error message link.
